The '''gimer stick''' was a wooden [[Cane/Legends|cane]] used by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and up until his [[Death/Legends|death]] shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The stick was made from the [[gimer bush]], which grew on many worlds including [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].

Yoda used his gimer stick as both a walking stick and a source of nutrients; gimer juice could be chewed out of the stick's bark, and was said to aid the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in his meditation. This juice could keep Yoda alive for a while, were he to be without food. In his old age, Yoda also chewed on his gimer stick to release a natural anesthetic. Such canes were believed to symbolize the ancient wisdom of a Jedi Master.

At some point prior to the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], Yoda received a gimer staff as a gift from the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], which was left behind during his [[Skirmish in the Senate|duel]] with [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] following the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].

At some point during his exile on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], Yoda received or created a new cane. He had this gimer rod during his first encounter with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and also even after his death and later becoming a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the computer game, ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', Yoda fights with his gimer stick. At the time, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|Star Wars: Episode II]], where he was seen to use a [[Yoda's lightsaber|lightsaber,]] had not yet been released.
